owner_decision: Option B2 and the CRC-domain correction approved without amendment on 2026-07-19.
finding: The earlier compact-vector proposal duplicated each heap obj in the logical resolution table and root vector. An immutable ordinal list removes duplication but costs 18 list reads plus 284 scattered value reads. C2D also has no content CRC; immutable membership belongs to the CRC-bound C2I descriptor stream.
claim_limit: Host-only contract correction and model. It changes no product byte, authorizes no capacity, makes no device or latency claim and does not run the product substitution link.

selected_candidate.immutable_membership_source: The identity-bound C2I-v2 descriptor kind stream; kind 3 and kind 7 only
selected_candidate.immutable_identity_chain: C2I metadata CRC -> image CRC -> L65S catalog CRC; C2D final header binds the verified catalog CRC
selected_candidate.canonical_root_index: zero-based rank among all preceding kind-3 and kind-7 descriptors
selected_candidate.root_value_storage: one contiguous mutable C2D root_values array; the only stored obj representation for heap-valued resolutions
selected_candidate.hot_window_materialization: descriptor range + resolution range + at most one contiguous root-value span per entry; fill Bank-0 literal cache before execution
selected_candidate.gc_rule: non-moving mark-sweep reads and marks every canonical root value and never writes one back

rejected_interpretations.reason: second mutable value representation can desynchronize
single-source but 18 ordinal-list reads plus 284 scattered value reads per collection
the current 16-bit obj space has no collision-free marker; an ABI change is unnecessary

required_invariants: root membership is derived exclusively from immutable C2I descriptor kinds
every heap-kind resolution word equals its canonical root rank
heap obj values exist only in the canonical root_values section
the root-value span is active and zeroed before the first allocation
each new heap value is published to its canonical root slot before any later allocation
the collector is non-moving and never writes root values back
a copying or compacting GC requires a new C2D root protocol
C2D-v1 remains historical proof evidence; only C2D-v2 may enter the product
required_negative_fixtures: strict v1/v2 decoder mismatch in both directions
root count differs from immutable descriptor census
root section arithmetic overlap, truncation or trailing data
heap-kind resolution lacks its canonical root index
reordered, duplicated or out-of-range root index
direct-kind resolution interpreted as root index
zero or non-pointer root value in a published plane
next_authorized_action: Change the product decoder to C2D-v2 single-source roots and run the real substitution link.
